info.title: Queue OpenAPI for fal-ai/hidream-o1-image/dev
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the fal-ai/hidream-o1-image/dev queue.

num_inference_steps.title: Num Inference Steps
num_inference_steps.description: Number of denoising steps. The dev model is distilled for 28 steps.

keep_original_aspect.title: Keep Original Aspect
keep_original_aspect.description: When exactly one reference image is provided, preserve its aspect ratio for the output image.

output_format.title: Output Format
output_format.description: The format of the generated image.

sync_mode.title: Sync Mode
sync_mode.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI and the output data won't be available in the request history.

enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker
enable_safety_checker.description: Enable the safety checker on generated images.

guidance_scale.title: Guidance Scale
guidance_scale.description: Classifier-free guidance scale. The dev model uses 0.0 by default.

image_size.title: Image Size
image_size.description: Requested output image size. Dimensions are rounded down to a multiple of 32, up to about 2048x2048 pixels.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Text prompt for image generation, editing, or subject-driven personalization.
examples: A cinematic product photo of a ceramic mug on a marble counter, soft window light, shallow depth of field.

reference_image_urls.title: Reference Image Urls
reference_image_urls.description: Optional reference images. Use none for text-to-image, one for image editing, or multiple for subject-driven personalization.

has_nsfw_concepts.title: Has Nsfw Concepts
has_nsfw_concepts.description: Whether each generated image was flagged by the safety checker.

height.title: Height
height.description: The height of the generated image.

width.title: Width
width.description: The width of the generated image.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
